title: Qatar conflict events lead NTR returns
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Qatar GDELT conflict-event count 10d z-score > 1.5 leads NTR log returns by 2 days (+) via North Field urea and ammonia export halts; trade long NTR 6d [gdelt.qat.conflict_events -> finance.NTR.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.qat.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long NTR next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 3 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Null control: Qatar GDELT conflict-event count 20d z-score > 1 leads CF Industries log returns by 3 days (+) if the NTR backtest reflects a real Qatari urea/ammonia supply shock rather than war-regime beta; trade long CF 3d [gdelt.qat.conflict_events -> finance.CF.log_return] (parent: R2-0043)
